intro: Technology and cybersecurity sectors bore the brunt of the 68 incidents tracked under ai-security between April and August 2026, with critical infrastructure, government, and financial services also affected globally, including the United States and China. Threat actors Claude Mythos and OpenClaw were observed in these campaigns. High-severity vulnerabilities dominated the mix, led by CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) and CVE-2026-5752 (CVSS 9.3), alongside CVE-2026-44339, CVE-2026-44567, and CVE-2026-45303. The reporting period saw 32 high and 9 critical severities, with 14 informational and 6 medium entries.
